data.status: targeting a late August to early September opening
data.short_description: Anam Cara Irish Pub & Eatery is preparing to bring traditional Irish fare with a Louisiana twist to Covington. The family-friendly restaurant will offer lunch, dinner, Saturday brunch, live music, and broadcasts of LSU and Saints games.

Friends With Benefits is a dual-concept cocktail bar planned for the East Village, featuring one bar for technical, hyper-focused cocktails and another for approachable classics. The space will also serve sophisticated plates like yakitori, prawn toast, and oysters flamed in chicken fat.

Le Wine is a natural wine tavern planned for Dimes Square by the owners of Le Dive, taking over the former Two Bridges space. It will offer natural wine with small pairing plates like kalamata olives, charcuterie, and duck liver tartine.

Gonzales Wine Company, led by owner Cristina Gonzales, is opening a tasting room inside Ricochet Wine in McMinnville, pending an OLCC license renewal. The winery plans to offer tastings in Spanish to serve the Willamette Valley's Spanish-speaking community.

Andis Cafe is a new concept planned for the first floor of 1 N Franklin Street in the Loop by owner Joshua Fossitt of We're Here Hospitality. No opening date has been set, and the full name suggests food will be served alongside coffee.

Franchisee Sanaa Atkins is preparing to open a second Tifa Chocolate & Gelato location in the Greenside mixed-use development in the Greater Houston area. Her first location opened at The Shops at Baybrook in Webster last October.

data.location: 750 W Fir Street, Suite 105, San Diego, CA 92101
data.short_description: Divo Diva, a European-style coffee shop and wine bar owned by opera singers Victoria Robertson and Rosario Monetti, is planning a second location in Little Italy. The new spot will take over the former Influx Cafe space and feature a cafe, bakery, and dessert section.

data.location: 501 St Clair Ave W, Toronto, ON M5P 0A2, Canada
data.short_description: Taco Bell is preparing to open a new Toronto location at the base of the Rise Condominiums on St. Clair West, announced via a "coming soon" sign. It joins existing tenants Popeyes and A&W in the building.

The Woodlawn is transitioning from pop-up to a full-service brick-and-mortar restaurant and event space in Grand Crossing this fall. The team, which also runs Nafsi South Shore Beach, plans to serve brunch, lunch, and dinner with handcrafted cocktails.

data.location: 1044 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4M 1Z8, Canada
data.short_description: J. Arthur, a neighborhood bar and restaurant in Toronto's east end, has rebranded as The Jay while keeping the same ownership, team, food, and drink menu. New signage referencing the building's blue jay mural marks the transition.

data.location: 155 Kingston Rd E, Ajax, ON L1S 7J4, Canada
data.short_description: Ontario's first fully integrated Applebee's and IHOP is opening in Ajax at the existing Applebee's site, introducing IHOP to Durham Region. The grand opening includes a ribbon-cutting, pancake tower unveiling, and free pancakes for the first 100 customers.

data.location: 3604 Rogers Branch Rd, Wake Forest, NC 27587
data.short_description: Vira Bistro, from Ukrainian chef Artem Blauta, is a European-inspired restaurant taking over the former Cha House space in Wake Forest. The all-day menu will include tahini and harissa shakshuka, tuna carpaccio, and duck leg with berry sauce.

Tous Les Jours, a French-Asian-inspired bakery, is set to open this fall in Philadelphia's Northern Liberties on the ground floor of the Eight Two Eight residential complex. Franchisee Sellki Lee will operate the bakery, which specializes in cloud cakes, breads, and pastries.

Biscuitville Fresh Southern acquired a 0.93-acre commercial property in Kernersville for $1.62 million, potentially setting the stage for a second location in the town. The company has not yet confirmed plans for the property.

Vintner's Table, a family-owned Italian restaurant owned by Andrea and Marco Folino, is expanding to Ardmore. The menu will mirror its Phoenixville and Wyomissing locations with shareable plates, antipasti, Roman-style flatbreads, and homemade pasta.

data.location: 4121 Main at North Hills St, Raleigh, NC 27609
data.short_description: South Block, an Arlington, Virginia-based concept, is expanding to Raleigh's North Hills mixed-use development, joining Bartaco in the Main District. The brand specializes in handcrafted acai bowls, smoothies, juices, and toasts.
Joyride Taco House's Uptown Phoenix location will close on Aug. 2 before construction begins on a new concept replacing it.

Lado A Lado, a collaboration between Upward Projects and Chiwas Hospitality Group, is preparing to open this fall in Uptown Phoenix, replacing Joyride Taco House. The concept will feature Northern Mexican cuisine with open-flame and wood-fired cooking.

Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant is planning a new freestanding, one-story full-service restaurant with a patio at The Arboretum in Charlotte. The company has signed a lease and is pursuing development permits.

Hungry AF, an Atlanta-grown brand with 10 existing locations, is expanding to Tucker with a fall opening target. The brand is known for its fusion menu featuring pasta, wings, Philly cheesesteaks, hibachi rice, and smash burgers.

data.location: 1330 N Orange Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
data.short_description: Viet-Nomz, a fast-casual Vietnamese restaurant founded in 2016, is opening its fourth location in Winter Park. The new, larger space will launch with the existing menu of street tacos, banh mi, baos, and signature pho bowls, with new items planned.

data.location: 2709 17th Ave S, Suite A, Seattle, WA 98144
data.short_description: Takumi Sushi is a Japanese restaurant preparing to open in mid-August inside the Colina Apartments in Beacon Hill. It is owner Evan Xu's first business after 12+ years as a sushi chef, with seating for 30–40 guests and planned outdoor patio.

data.status: plans to open a brick-and-mortar restaurant
data.short_description: Bearded Chef Brunch, known for Southern brunch classics, submitted plan review paperwork for a brick-and-mortar at 1629 University Blvd N in Jacksonville. The menu features items like the Wendall Burger and Country Skillet Plate.

Heidi's Coffee & Cream, a new coffee and ice cream spot, will open at 531 S Eighth St in Fernandina Beach per a submitted plan review. It received Main Street's Façade Improvement Grant to help cover building improvements.

Mrs. Thelma's Southern Cuisine, a new Southern comfort food restaurant, is opening at 119 49th St S in St. Pete, offering takeout and dine-in with seating for about 12 guests. Owners Melvin Holt and Nicole Rollins-Holt describe it as a legacy project honoring Holt's late mother.

TOUS les JOURS, an international French-Asian bakery chain, is expected to debut its third Central Ohio location in Fall 2026 at 10726 Sawmill Parkway, Suite 102 in Powell. It joins existing bakeries in Columbus and Dublin.

data.location: 10 S Pinellas Ave, Tarpon Springs, FL 34689
data.status: an opening is in the works
data.short_description: Catalina's La Cantina, a Mexican restaurant, submitted plan review documents for its long-anticipated opening at 10 S Pinellas Avenue in Tarpon Springs. The concept promises "50 Tequilas & Six Taps," fresh tamales daily, and a scratch menu.

Casa East Sac, an East Sacramento American comfort restaurant, permanently closed effective July 15, 2026, per an Instagram announcement by owners Steve and Theodore Gibanov. The owners cited ongoing small-business challenges as the reason.

Captain D's, a fast-casual seafood restaurant, celebrated the grand opening of its Corsicana location on Monday, July 13, marking its 19th Texas location. The 1,950-square-foot free-standing restaurant seats 44 guests and is owned by franchisee Joseph Omobogie.

data.location: 401 Newport Center Dr, Newport Beach, CA 92660
data.status: opening at Fashion Island in August, 2026
data.short_description: Telefèric Barcelona, a Spanish tapas restaurant with eight CA and AZ locations, is opening at Fashion Island in Newport Beach in August 2026. Originally founded in Barcelona in 1992, it is celebrating its 10-year stateside anniversary.

Wind and Sea Restaurant, a historic steak and seafood spot at Dana Point Harbor founded in 1972, will serve its final meal on September 15, 2026 after 54 years. The team announced the 60-day countdown via social media on July 15.

data.event_date: before the end of this year
data.status: construction slated to wrap up in late November
data.short_description: Sal e Brasa, a Brazilian steakhouse, is set to open its third Texas location in Houston's Uptown/Galleria area, with construction planned to start in September and wrap in late November. The $1.2 million project takes over the former Chacho's space.

data.status: grand opening day celebration starting at 6:00 AM on Thursday, July 16
data.short_description: Panera Bread, via franchisee Hamra Enterprises, is opening its first Texas cafe at 3548 Rayford Rd in Spring on July 16, part of a seven-location Greater Houston rollout. The Houston-area Paneras had been dark since August 2025 following a franchise dispute and bankruptcy.

data.status: planned for Katy later this year
data.short_description: Panera Bread's next Katy location under Hamra Enterprises is planned for 25546 Kingsland Blvd later this year. It is part of a seven-cafe rollout across Houston, Spring, Katy, and Conroe.

data.short_description: 204 Washington Tavern is preparing to open at 204 Washington Street in East Walpole in the former 204 Washington Restaurant & Bar space, backed by Napper Tandy's owner John Jacob. The 4,009-square-foot venue will seat up to 120 across the dining room and a 60-foot outdoor patio.

data.location: 1 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue, Memphis, TN 38103
data.short_description: Walt & Ricky's Seafood Kitchen, a destination seafood restaurant by hospitality veteran Mowbray Rowand, is opening later this year at 1 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue in Downtown Memphis. It takes over the space formerly occupied by Fancy's Fish House and will feature a raw bar and Southern-influenced seafood menu.

data.store_name: Fiery Crab Seafood Restaurant and Bar
data.status: prepares to open its newest location
data.short_description: Fiery Crab Seafood Restaurant and Bar, known for customizable Cajun-style seafood boils, is opening a new location at 2103 Pinnacle Pkwy in Covington. The restaurant is hiring for all positions ahead of the opening.

data.status: construction expected to wrap by the end of the year
data.short_description: Snarf's Sandwiches is planning a new location at 2005 Fort Worth Avenue in Dallas's Kessler Park neighborhood, with construction expected to wrap by year-end. Founded in Boulder, Colorado in 1996, the chain has grown to nearly 50 locations across Colorado, Missouri, and Texas.

data.short_description: Tim Hortons is planning a new Leander location at 15513 Ronald Reagan Blvd, Suite 110, under franchisee TexBrew LLC as part of its Austin-metro rollout. Construction is expected to wrap by year-end.

Acropolis of Mandeville has rebranded as Compagno's at 1600 W Causeway Approach, reviving owner Michael Compagno's family restaurant legacy dating back to 1929. The refreshed concept features updated décor, new branding, and a menu blending grandmother's original recipes with Italian classics.

data.short_description: The nearly 120-year-old building at 2100 Larimer Street in Denver's Ballpark neighborhood is being redeveloped by Matt Van Sistine and Blair Gifford into a boutique hotel, restaurant, bar, and entertainment destination. Construction is targeted to begin within the next two to three months, possibly reviving the historic Western Hotel name.

data.status: targeting a September opening, pending inspections
data.short_description: Qisa Coffee, the Curtis Park café open since 2024, is expanding to a second location at 2121 Natomas Crossing Drive in North Natomas, owner Aziz confirmed. It is targeting a September opening pending inspections and will be an upgraded, more luxurious version of the original.

data.status: hoping to open by the end of this year
data.short_description: La Casita Bakeshop is relocating within downtown Rowlett to a bigger space at 3522 Main St., Suite 300, with the team hoping to open by the end of the year. The new location will add brunch and lunch service, with dinner potentially later.

La Casita Bakeshop is moving from its original downtown Rowlett location, described as one of its first shops that only fits four or five people, to a larger space down the street. The move is a relocation, not a further expansion.

Kalamazoo local Mike "Tonto" Alexander is opening his coney island concept Tonto's Coney World at 3621 Stadium Drive near Western Michigan University, in the former Hertz space. The opening date is looking like Aug. 5 or later, and the site is under construction.

data.location: 363 Green Valley Rd, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
data.status: targeting an opening before the end of 2026
data.short_description: Lake House, a new lake-inspired restaurant from partners Eric Rushing and Thomas Holzmann, is coming to 363 Green Valley Road in El Dorado Hills, the former Purple Place site. The duo is targeting an opening before the end of 2026 with no hard date set, focusing on new American comfort food with a brunch and breakfast program.

data.store_name: The Purple Place Bar and Grill
data.location: 363 Green Valley Rd, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
data.short_description: The Purple Place Bar and Grill, founded in 1955 as El Dorado Hills' original roadhouse, closed in August 2022 after lease negotiations broke down. The building has sat vacant for three years since.

Pub International in Myrtle Beach is taking over the neighboring 4,000-square-foot space to create two different vibes under one roof, adding a 44-foot bar, outdoor patio, DJ booth, dance floor, and more. No official opening date has been announced, but renovations are underway with hopes of finishing before the end of summer.

Pulido's Kitchen and Cantina will officially close its Hurst location at 1224 Precinct Line Rd. on July 16. The Tex-Mex chain, founded in Fort Worth in 1966, gave no official reason; its Willow Park and Eastland locations remain open.

Campus Burgers, a California-based smash burger chain, is opening its first San Diego location in Pacific Beach at 978 Garnet Avenue, in the former Food Box space. Work is underway to open by Labor Day Weekend, with 1,000 free burgers and fries planned for the grand opening. It marks the brand's Southern California debut.

Grill Nine, a Korean BBQ and steakhouse, is working on a second Henderson location according to Affordable Tax & Accounting's Brian J. Lee. Owner Steven Kwon did not confirm the exact address or timeline, and it is anticipated to open sometime this year.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Colectivo Coffee is planning a new cafe at 2032 W Roscoe Street in Roscoe Village, per Chicago Business Journal. An opening date has not been announced but it will be sometime in the fall.

Colectivo Coffee recently opened a location at 3258 N Southport Avenue in Lakeview. The Roscoe Village cafe follows this recent Lakeview opening as part of the company's continued expansion in the city.

data.location: 415 E St Elmo Rd, Austin, TX 78745
data.short_description: C.L. Butaud will permanently close its South Austin tasting room at 415 E St. Elmo Road on July 26, citing rising rent and financial strain. The winery will continue operating online and is actively searching for a new Austin location.

Everdine's Grilled Cheese Co. is closing its downtown Naperville location permanently on July 17, after nearly a decade. The family-owned restaurant did not disclose a reason; its Batavia location will remain open.

data.status: awaiting final permitting; plan to open soon
data.short_description: FNF Hot Burger is opening a location at Phipps Plaza, joining the food hall on the first floor. The company is awaiting final permitting to determine the exact date but plans to open soon, with a grand opening later this summer.

Cellar Hand, a wine-focused restaurant in Hillcrest founded by the Perr family, will close its doors on July 19 after a two-year run. It was named one of Wine Enthusiast's Top 50 New Restaurants in 2025 and will host a Pride Brunch and pizza party on July 18 before its final day.

data.status: will relocate/move into the former Cellar Hand space
data.short_description: Pali Wine Co. will relocate its tasting room into the former Cellar Hand space following that restaurant's closure. Both Cellar Hand and Pali Wine Co. are owned by the Perr family.

data.location: Little Italy, San Diego, CA (address not specified)
data.short_description: Pali Wine Co. will move its tasting room from its Little Italy location to the former Cellar Hand space in Hillcrest. The relocation was announced by the Perr family, who own both brands.
N/A

Harlem Shake, an award-winning burger and shake concept founded by Jelena Pasic, is set to debut at 1330 Walnut St. in Philadelphia. It marks the brand's first franchise location and first outpost outside New York, where it operates in Harlem and Brooklyn.

data.event_date: early fall around Labor Day weekend
data.short_description: Patisserie and neighborhood cafe Bloom is under construction and will open in early fall around Labor Day weekend at Highside Market in Columbus, owner Ritesh Mali said. It will offer a European "cakes and bubbles" concept with French and Italian pastries alongside wines, champagnes, and afternoon tea.

Frenchette Bakery opened its third location on July 14 at 370 Broome Street in Nolita, a corner space at Broome and Mott streets, open daily 8 am to 4 pm. Founded by Lee Hanson and Riad Nasr, the new shop introduces an expanded menu including the bakery's first bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich and a refrigerated pastry case.

data.status: construction is progressing; targeting an early fall opening
data.short_description: The Bagelry is opening a third Cincinnati-area location at 11013 Montgomery Road in Montgomery, bringing house-made bagels and breakfast sandwiches. Owner Richard Huff said construction is progressing and the team is targeting an early fall opening. The roughly 3,000-square-foot restaurant will be the company's largest to date.

Chickadee, a Mediterranean restaurant in Boston's Seaport District, is closing after eight years, with its final day of service on July 18. Located in the Innovation and Design Building and owned by chef John daSilva, it was a 2025 James Beard Awards semifinalist. The team did not provide a reason for the closure.

Shook Shakery, a new milkshake chain, is slated to open four locations in Southern Nevada this year, with the first coming to Henderson at 3360 St Rose Parkway, per the Review-Journal. Partner Dena Tripp, a co-founder of Nothing Bundt Cakes, confirmed the opening. The $9 shakes will come in 15 flavors across three categories.

Vitaliy Vinnichuk took over Tupelo Coffee about two months ago, acquiring the East Sacramento location. New housemade syrups and specialty drinks like a strawberry matcha and grapefruit tonic are being added to the menu.

Vinnichuk took over the former Naked Coffee shop at 1500 Q St in Midtown about two months ago and is rebranding it as Tupelo. This closes the book on the last remaining Naked Coffee location in Sacramento.

data.status: closing the book on the last remaining Naked Coffee location
data.short_description: The last remaining Naked Coffee location in Sacramento is being rebranded as Tupelo Coffee following Vinnichuk's acquisition.

Char is a new Vietnamese grill-focused concept from Mamba Hospitality Group, opening alongside sister concept Ocean Palace. Inspired by the traditional Bò 7 Món experience, it will feature premium grilled meats and interactive tabletop dining.

data.status: planned for a fall opening / grand opening on October 3rd
data.short_description: Pho Prime is set to open at Stomping Grounds in Garden Oaks this fall, with a grand opening planned for October 3rd, barring final permit approvals. The space was previously occupied by Pho Fix, which closed in January.
Kitchens for Good is preparing to open a public-facing Market Café at its new 29,000-square-foot Culinary Impact Center in Bankers Hill. Apprentices will prepare and serve food while earning wages.

Scaddabush is preparing to open in the former Swiss Chalet space in Aurora, with renovations underway and a banner announcing "opening soon." An exact date has not been announced but the location is expected to open this summer.
Scaddabush is preparing to open a new Kanata restaurant, expanding the brand's presence in Ontario. The location is scheduled to open on August 1, 2026.
The former Swiss Chalet space in Aurora closed in February and will be taken over by Scaddabush Italian Kitchen & Bar.

data.status: soft opening planned / grand opening scheduled
data.short_description: Pali Wine Co. is relocating its San Diego tasting room to Hillcrest, moving into the former Cellar Hand space. A soft opening is planned for August 12 with a grand opening scheduled for August 22.

Pali Wine Co. will close its Little Italy tasting room on July 19, 2026, as the company relocates to Hillcrest. The move was driven by lease negotiations after the landlord sought to nearly double the rent.
Cellar Hand is permanently closing on July 19, 2026, after a little more than two years of operation. Pali Wine Co. will take over the space for its new Hillcrest tasting room.

St. Louis Bar & Grill is planning a new Niagara location, listed among future franchise locations on the company's website. The chain is expanding its Ontario presence with locations also planned for Winnipeg, Edmundston, and Sault Ste. Marie.

data.status: targeted for opening / grand opening planned
data.short_description: Big Sharks Fish and Chicken plans to open its third location in Bellmead per public filings. Owner Mohammed Shawabkeh is targeting late September to early November 2026 with a Chicago-style menu of wings, fish, seafood, smash burgers, and sandwiches.

Clubhouse 56 is expanding to a second location inside WildHawk Golf Club, taking over the clubhouse restaurant from the previous operator. A liquor license under TLC Legacy LLC confirms the transition is underway.

data.location: 145 W Hillcrest Dr, Thousand Oaks, CA 91360
data.short_description: Yard House is slated to join the Collection at Janss in Thousand Oaks, listed as "coming soon" in the shopping center's directory map. The restaurant is currently in the permitting process with the city.

Biscuit Bitch plans its first new location since 2019, taking over the former Wann Izakaya space in Belltown. At 4,856 square feet, it will be the brand's largest location and serve as its commissary kitchen.

data.location: 160 W Mountain Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80524
data.short_description: Grazia Craft Kitchen & Cocktails is planned for the historic William S. Hill building in Old Town Fort Collins. Owner Adrian Hembree submitted plans to the city and is targeting a February 1, 2027 opening.

data.location: 9700 S Parker Rd, Suite 700, Parker, CO 80138
data.short_description: South Korean salad chain Salady is expanding to Parker Gateway Marketplace. The fast-casual concept offers salads, warm grain bowls, wraps, and customizable options.

New York City's Soda Club is opening its second location inside The Ramble Hotel in Denver, taking over the former Super Mega Bien space. The menu features handmade pasta, Roman-style pinsa, and a natural wine program.
Super Mega Bien at The Ramble Hotel closed earlier this year, with Soda Club taking over the space.
Slice House by Tony Gemignani is planning a Camarillo location, per a social media post from franchisee Vinny Margott. The team did not share further details on opening timeline.

data.location: Montalvo Square Shopping Center, Ventura, CA
data.short_description: A Ventura location at Montalvo Square Shopping Center is slated to open this month, marking franchisee Vinny Margott's seventh location with the brand.

data.location: 8700 E Pinnacle Peak Rd, Suite 106, Scottsdale, AZ 85255
data.short_description: Little Scoops is an old-fashioned ice cream parlor from Chef Sheila Bryson's Soul Hospitality Group, opening next to Little Snitch in North Scottsdale. It will operate as a casual counter-service parlor connected to Little Snitch.

data.location: 8700 E Pinnacle Peak Rd, Scottsdale, AZ 85255
data.short_description: ALMA Scottsdale is reopening at The Citadel in North Scottsdale this fall with a reimagined Southwest steakhouse concept. The new location will also feature Copper Club rooftop lounge, a tequila bar, and the return of Barbwire Western Couture.
ALMA's Old Town Scottsdale location closed earlier this year, prompting the relocation to The Citadel near founder Sheila Bryson's other Soul Hospitality Group concepts.
Hungry Habibi is opening its third location in Shelby Township in a former beauty salon space. The team has just started the hiring process and no official opening date has been announced.

data.store_name: Chef Mark Bolchoz new concept (name not announced)
data.short_description: Chef Mark Bolchoz of Semper Elevatum Hospitality Group is opening a new concept in the former Dashi space that blends coastal Lowcountry traditions with western Irish pub spirit. It will serve fish and chips alongside Guinness.

data.short_description: Totally Awesome Bar is making a comeback this summer after closing in February, with new owners Jay Trikha and a business partner taking over. The retro '80s and '90s theme will remain, with upgrades to bathrooms, stage, lighting, and sound system.

Lucky's Steakhouse, a Montecito-based high-end steakhouse, is planning to take over the Nerano space in Beverly Hills with a December opening. It is part of the Montesano Group portfolio and has existing locations in Montecito, Malibu, SoHo, and East Hampton.
Nerano, owned by Carlo and Andy Brandon-Gordon, is closing on July 25 after nearly ten years in Beverly Hills. Lucky's Steakhouse is planning to take over the space.

data.status: estimated opening date right now is around September or October
data.short_description: Cafe Purrfection is a new cafe concept by owner Caroline Jamil that will feature a room where guests can meet cats available for adoption via the Animal Rescue Foundation. The exact address is not yet released but will be near Block 59 on Highway 59 in Naperville, with an estimated opening in September or October.

Angry Chickz, a Nashville hot chicken chain with more than 40 locations, is opening its first Rocklin restaurant on July 24 with a drive-thru. Grand opening promotions include gifts for the first 100 customers and a drawing for free Angry Chickz for a year.

data.short_description: Grease Burger Beer and Whiskey Bar, a longtime sports-oriented bar known for 10 oz burgers, is permanently closing on July 17 in downtown West Palm Beach. The restaurant is marking its final week with a 'Last Call Week' promotion featuring $5 whiskeys and bourbons.
